faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Practical answers about our cleaning services in Paphos, Limassol and surrounding areas.

items.a: We provide cleaning services in Paphos, Limassol and surrounding areas. Send us your location and we’ll confirm availability for your property.

items.q: Do I need to provide cleaning products or equipment?
items.a: No. Our team arrives with the professional cleaning products and equipment required for the agreed service. If you have allergies, pets, sensitive surfaces or specific product preferences, please tell us when you make your enquiry.

items.q: How long does a cleaning service take?
items.a: The time required depends on the property size, condition and scope of work. Once we receive your details, we can give you a more useful estimate.
Yes. Regular cleaning can be arranged weekly, every two weeks or on another schedule, subject to availability and the needs of your property.

items.q: Do you clean Airbnb and holiday rental properties?
items.a: Yes. We provide turnover cleaning for Airbnb and holiday rentals, including property preparation, trash removal, wet cleaning and linen change when agreed.

items.q: Do you clean offices and commercial spaces?
items.a: Yes. We provide one-off and regular cleaning for offices and commercial spaces in Paphos, Limassol and surrounding areas. The scope is arranged around the size and needs of the property.

items.q: Do you offer move-in and move-out cleaning?
items.a: Yes. We clean apartments, houses and rental properties before move-in or after move-out, helping prepare the space for handover or the next occupants.
Yes. We provide post-renovation cleaning for apartments, houses and other properties. The scope and final price depend on the size and condition of the space after the work is completed.

items.q: Do you clean sofas, upholstery and carpets?
items.a: Yes. We provide deep cleaning for sofas, upholstered furniture and carpets. The appropriate method and price depend on the size, material and condition.

items.q: Do you provide car interior cleaning?
items.a: Yes. We clean car interiors, including seats, carpets, floor areas and other interior surfaces depending on the vehicle and its condition. Exterior car washing is not included.

items.q: Can I book oven, refrigerator or window cleaning separately?
items.a: Yes. These specialty services can be booked separately without a full property clean. Oven and refrigerator cleaning can also be booked together as the Kitchen Essentials bundle.

items.q: How is the final price calculated?
items.a: Prices on the website are starting prices. The final price depends on the property size, condition, access and agreed scope of work, and is confirmed after we review the details.

items.q: Can I send my request through WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes. You can use the booking form or contact us directly on WhatsApp. We’ll review your details and contact you to confirm the service and final arrangements.

privacyText: We collect the information you choose to send through our booking or contact channels so we can respond to your enquiry and arrange services.
We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared only with service providers needed to operate communications or the website, subject to appropriate safeguards.
You may contact us to ask about, correct or request deletion of personal information we hold, subject to applicable obligations.
cookiesText: This website may use essential browser storage to remember language preferences and whether the short opening animation has already been shown.
Essential storage supports basic website functionality. Analytics or marketing cookies should not be added without updating this policy and, where required, requesting consent.
termsText: A booking form submission is a request, not an automatic confirmation. A service is arranged only after Blue Wave Cleaning confirms availability, scope and price.
Guide prices may change according to property size, condition, access and the agreed scope of work. Any material changes should be agreed before service begins.
Specific access, product, cancellation and other change arrangements should be confirmed directly when the booking is accepted.
